falsification_calls.evidence: smooth distance 1.999 versus contact residual distance 0.843; smooth-core test graphlets have SE/RSE 0 and one local maximum, unlike empirical PHOT graphlets
falsification_calls.interpretation: The smooth core alone is rejected as an empirical graphlet fit; this falsifier did not break the model.

falsification_calls.evidence: Fixed contact scale 1->4->16 moves SE, RSE, local maxima, WHT/GFT high-order fraction upward and lag-1 autocorrelation downward; all six registered directional Spearman tests pass.
falsification_calls.interpretation: The fixed residual-scale knob survives and supports HYP-005 narrowly.

falsification_calls.evidence: primary PHOT empirical graphlets have low GFT fraction 0.606, GFT high fraction 0.147, and WHT high-order fraction 0.394; the WHT high-order component exceeds the preregistered non-dominant tail ceiling of 0.35
falsification_calls.interpretation: This falsifies the clean low-order-dominant plus modest high-order-tail envelope for the relevant primary empirical panel.

falsification_calls.evidence: contact residual distance 0.843 is better than random-position 1.285, shuffled-contact 1.300, and GNK 1.241 under the registered distance criterion
falsification_calls.interpretation: Matched controls do not equal the contact residual as written, but this does not prove biological contact causality because residual-only is closer than all embedded procedural models.

falsification_calls.evidence: best overall distance is residual-only diagnostic (0.739), not the embedded contact residual (0.843); contact residual underestimates empirical local maxima (2.02 vs 4.96) and WHT high-order fraction (0.044 vs 0.394), while residual-only gives negative lag-1 autocorrelation (-0.197 vs empirical 0.174) and zero accessibility
falsification_calls.interpretation: No tested procedural candidate matches empirical spectra, local-maxima, accessibility, and random-walk statistics as a package; this falsifies the strong empirical procedural adequacy claim.

falsification_calls.evidence: global-readout residuals retain high-order signal: mean retained high-order fraction is 4.821 overall and 4.821 in the primary PHOT panel; PHOT residual high-order fraction is 0.948 after additive-plus-polynomial readout subtraction
falsification_calls.interpretation: High-order signal is not explained away by the nonlinear/global-readout control; this falsifier did not break the model.

control_equivalence.falsifier: Matched controls match empirical graphlets as well as contact residuals.

no_residual_scale_effect.falsifier: Residual scale is not directional across the fixed-scale grid.

scale_confounding.falsifier: Observed high-order WHT signal disappears after nonlinear global-readout correction.

smooth_core_only_empirical_fit.falsifier: Smooth core or additive global-readout model matches empirical topology and spectra.

wrong_evolutionary_dynamics.falsifier: Closest spectral models fail topology/accessibility/random-walk dynamics.

wrong_spectral_envelope.falsifier: Empirical graphlets lack low-order dominance with a measurable high-order tail.

overall_interpretation.formal_hypothesis_effect_hyp004: weakens; falsifies strong current implementation/benchmark adequacy form, but does not alone refute every adaptive-walk prediction in HYP-004
overall_interpretation.summary: RUN-071 supports residual scale directionality and rejects smooth/readout-only explanations, but the empirical PHOT graphlets have a stronger WHT high-order component than the preregistered envelope and no embedded procedural candidate matches spectra plus topology plus evolutionary dynamics as a package.
